body:
Full-codebase review, web finding. Verified by reading both clients.

`ListPropsPage.handleDuplicate` pushes only `name`, `category_order` and `notes`, so the server applies the default kind and a duplicated checklist comes back as a shopping list, showing the stores/price/quantity fields the original hid. Android's `ListsRepo.duplicate` copies `kind`.

Fix direction: include the kind in the pushed fields. Duplicate is not offered for a ledger, so the fixed-kind rule is not at risk. Test gap: the existing duplicate test never asserts the kind, and its fixture list has none.
title: Web: duplicating a list drops its kind
